supersedes_nothing: v1 (benchmarks/debugger-skill-effect-v1) stays as recorded; v2 is a separate corpus and question.
hypothesis: On real public Playwright/Cypress failures whose merged upstream fix is the ground truth, a zero-tool model that receives the debugger skill text identifies the maintainers' root-cause mechanism more often than the same model given no taxonomy at all (plain 'diagnose the root cause' prompt), and than the same model given only the F-code legend.

arms.skill: prompt frame + full debugger skill text + excerpt; 7-field F-code schema
arms.legend: prompt frame + 15-line F-code legend + excerpt; same 7-field schema
arms.free: taxonomy-free prompt: diagnose root cause and fix; 3-field schema (diagnosis, root_cause, fix)

primary_comparison: skill minus free, strict judge match (score 2) per call, mean per case, paired per-case difference
secondary_comparisons: F-code exact match skill vs legend on blind-agreed labels
diagnosis (product vs test) accuracy against the maintainers' attribution
tokens and wall time per arm

judge.blind: sees maintainers' explanation and fix plus all candidate root-cause statements for one case in shuffled order with letter ids; never sees arm, model, or F-code
judge.rubric: 2 same mechanism; 1 right family wrong mechanism; 0 different or vague

case_sources: 26 cases from 12 merged fixes in 11 MIT/Apache-2.0 repositories; artifacts hold observations only, truth holds the maintainers' explanation and fix (see corpus.construction_rule)

labels.f_code: two blind mappers (Claude Opus, Claude Sonnet; saw only explanation + fix + F tables) agreed on 15/26; 11 disputed cases carry no F-code label and are excluded from the F-code metric only
labels.diagnosis: maintainers' own product/test attribution where stated; otherwise test_defect when only test code changed

decision_rule.ci: paired case-cluster bootstrap of per-case strict-match differences (skill minus free), stratified by framework
decision_rule.PASS: skill-minus-free lift >= min_lift AND bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0 AND skill diagnosis accuracy >= free diagnosis accuracy - max_diagnosis_drop
decision_rule.FAIL: all model calls scored, all judge calls parsed, no input drift, and PASS conditions not met
decision_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: any unscored model call after the retry policy, any unparsed judge call, or any input digest drift

power_note: 26 cases. Assuming a paired per-case SD of 0.35, the minimum detectable effect is about 0.20 at alpha 0.05 and power 0.8; a true +0.10 can be missed. No pilot variance was available.
limits: Cases were found through GitHub search for merged flaky-test fixes, so they over-represent timing and isolation causes and under-represent other F-codes; 18 Playwright and 8 Cypress.
The author selected and redacted the artifacts; redaction decisions are documented per case and auditable through the source URLs, but a different redaction could change difficulty.
Several source PR descriptions were written with AI coding assistants; the ground truth is the fix the maintainers merged, not an independent human adjudication.
The judge is a model (Codex gpt-6-sol), blind to arm but not human.
A zero-tool prompt measures interpretation of the skill text, not the end-to-end debugger workflow.
The legend and skill arms are forced to pick an F-code; the free arm is not, so F-code exact match is reported only between skill and legend.
